subject.title: [BUG] drive list/info ignore pagination; info falsely reports File not found past page 1

question: What should the permanent Feishu Drive `info` lookup contract be for files beyond the first folder page?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the public tool contract needs maintainer intent because Feishu bot credentials do not have a browsable root and unconditional root draining would create the wrong product promise.

options.title: Add folder-scoped info lookup
options.body: Add an optional concrete `folder_token` to `info`, paginate only within that folder, and document that root lookup remains limited for bot credentials.

options.title: Keep info root-limited
options.body: Leave `info` as a root/first-page helper and document that users must use paginated `list` to browse shared folders before requesting metadata.

options.title: Reject cross-page info lookup
options.body: Treat the merged list continuation as sufficient and close the remaining `info` request as unsupported product behavior.

recommendation.title: Add folder-scoped info lookup
recommendation.body: Add an optional concrete `folder_token` to `info`, paginate only within that folder, and document that root lookup remains limited for bot credentials.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the list half and posted the current maintainer context that the remaining behavior needs a folder-aware contract and proof.
